title: SplitBill custom A2UI components
description: Project-owned chart components added next to the vendored basic catalog. Not part of the upstream A2UI spec; kept outside spec/v0_9 so the vendored files stay verbatim (see spec/v0_9/SOURCE.md). The web renderer mirrors these in web/src/a2ui/charts.tsx.

ChartItem.description: One labelled value of a chart, e.g. one person's amount.

label.description: What the value belongs to, e.g. a person's name.

value.description: A non-negative number that sets the bar length / slice size. Copy it verbatim from get_summary; never compute it.

displayText.description: Preformatted text shown next to the item, e.g. "1400.00 MDL".

color.description: Optional #RRGGBB override. Omit it: the renderer assigns a colour-blind-safe palette by position.

ChartItems.description: A literal array of chart items, or a binding to such an array in the data model.

BarChart.description: Horizontal bars comparing non-negative amounts, e.g. who paid how much. Each bar is labelled with its label and displayText.

PieChart.description: Shares of a whole as a pie or donut with a legend, e.g. each person's share of the total.

donut.description: true draws a ring with a hollow centre; false a full pie.
